0.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_GREETING_CHARLEMEND_000_000
0.description: Lest you forget, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, our task is to replenish the infirmary's stores of daily necessities─dining utensils, bedding, and the like. We thank you for your kind assistance.

1.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_GREETING_CHARLEMEND_000_001
1.description: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. If you have the medical supplies we require, I should be glad to take them off your hands.

2.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_GREETING_CHARLEMEND_000_002
2.description: <hex:02084CE3E90C0DFF24020820E3E90C05FF0D476F6F64206576656E696E67FF0C476F6F64206D6F72726F7703FF2102081DE3E90C12FF09476F6F6420646179FF0D476F6F64206576656E696E670303> to you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. As you will recall, rehabilitation aids such as walking sticks and wheelchairs are the order of the day.

3.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_GREETING_CHARLEMEND_000_003
3.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, we are currently preparing to host a high tea for our patients. Your assistance in the way of supplies would be appreciated.

4.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_GREETING_CHARLEMEND_000_004
4.description: Welcome, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, welcome. I believe I speak for all at Ser Vaindreau's Grace when I say we are always glad for your visit.

44.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_TUTORIAL_000_000
44.description: Help Charlemend achieve his goals by delivering collectables. For more information, speak with him and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Learn about custom deliveries<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

55.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_TUTORIAL_001_000
55.description: In making your first successful delivery, you have begun to earn Charlemend's trust.

56.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_TUTORIAL_001_001
56.description: With each successful delivery, Charlemend will grow more and more satisfied with your efforts. Fill the gauge completely and Charlemend's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>satisfaction level<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will increase, giving you the opportunity to learn more about your new business partner.

57.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_TUTORIAL_001_002
57.description: You can make up to six deliveries in a given week. Deliver the items Charlemend needs, and deliver them often to win the trust and praise of your new business partner!

59.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_001_000
59.description: Excellent, these necessities will serve our patients well. Cleanliness being of the essence, I will see to disinfecting these ere they are put to use. But first, a little inspection for good measure...

60.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_001_001
60.description: From metal receptacles to cloth bandages, medical equipment must be made to exacting standards. Having come from your hands, I expect this will be more than satisfactory, but it would be remiss of me not to perform an inspection. If you'll excuse me...

61.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_001_002
61.description: Safety is paramount when it comes to rehabilitation, and any equipment used must be sturdy and durable. Having come from your hands, I expect this will be more than satisfactory, but it would be remiss of me not to perform an inspection. If you'll excuse me...

62.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_001_003
62.description: In a snow-swept nation such as ours, nobles and commoners alike are partial to a steaming cup of tea served with sweets. These items will allow us to host an event that our patients will enjoy. Now, if I might take a closer look...

63.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_001_004
63.description: Painting provides not only a means of relaxation, but rehabilitation besides. These supplies will allow our patients to enjoy the benefits of exercising their artistry as they continue their journey of healing. Now, if I might take a closer look...

64.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_002_000
64.description: Brought us some lye, have you? Excellent. The infirmary ever has need of soap, and this will make a goodly amount of the stuff. Now, if I might take a closer look...

65.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_002_001
65.description: From metal receptacles to cloth bandages, medical equipment must be made of quality materials. Having come from your hands, I expect this will be more than satisfactory, but it would be remiss of me not to perform an inspection. If you'll excuse me...

66.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_002_002
66.description: Safety is paramount when it comes to rehabilitation, and the materials used in any equipment must be sturdy and durable. Having come from your hands, I expect this will be more than satisfactory, but it would be remiss of me not to perform an inspection. If you'll excuse me...

67.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_002_003
67.description: In a snow-swept nation such as ours, nobles and commoners alike are partial to a steaming cup of tea served with sweets. Using this ingredient, we can prepare a toothsome syrup that our patients will enjoy. Now, if I might take a closer look...

68.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_002_004
68.description: Painting provides not only a means of relaxation, but rehabilitation besides. With this ingredient, we can prepare colors for our patients to use in their artistic endeavors. Now, if I might take a closer look...

69.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_003_000
69.description: Brought us a scallop, have you? Excellent. The infirmary ever has need of soap, and the powder obtained from its shell will make a goodly amount of the stuff. Now, if I might take a closer look...

70.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_003_001
70.description: Ah, yes, from this variety of kelp, we can distill an extract with potent disinfecting properties─that is, assuming the specimen is sufficiently lush. Let us take a closer look...

71.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_003_002
71.description: Rehabilitation is all too often a painful process, but from this frog's poison, we can concoct a medicine that effectively dulls pain. Now, if I might take a closer look at the critter...

72.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_003_003
72.description: I am told that, in the Far East, it is customary to burn incense when drinking tea. Using such delightful seashells as incense burners, we can fill the room with a soothing scent. Now, if I might take a closer look...

73.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_KNOWLEDGE_CHARLEMEND_003_004
73.description: Ah, yes, this fish is considered a delicacy even among nobility. As tasty as it is nutritious, it will allow us to prepare meals that nourish the body even as it pleases the palate. Now, if I might take a closer look...

74.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_JUDGEMENT_CHARLEMEND_000_000
74.description: Hm, yes, nothing to be desired. You are true to your reputation, my friend.

75.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_JUDGEMENT_CHARLEMEND_000_001
75.description: Hm-hm, even to my layman's eyes, 'tis plain the quality is superior. Maelie will surely be pleased.

76.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_JUDGEMENT_CHARLEMEND_000_002
76.description: By the Fury, even to my layman's eyes, 'tis plain the quality is transcendent! I cannot show this to Maelie soon enough!

77.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_JUDGEMENT_CHARLEMEND_000_003
77.description: Hm, yes, very fine stuff indeed! This will be a high tea to remember, mark my words!

78.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_JUDGEMENT_CHARLEMEND_000_004
78.description: Hm, yes, very fine stuff indeed! It will help to bring a touch of joy to our patients' lives!

79.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_FULLBAG_000_000
79.description: Unable to obtain your reward. Your inventory is full.

80.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_FULLBAG_000_001
80.description: To collect your reward, make room in your inventory and speak with Charlemend once more.

81.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_BEFRANKUP_CHARLEMEND_000_000
81.description: With this latest contribution, we now have the requisite amount of necessities. You have my gratitude.

82.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_BEFRANKUP_CHARLEMEND_001_000
82.description: Thanks to you, we now have all the medical supplies we require at present. A moment while I summon Maelie hither.

83.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_BEFRANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_000
83.description: We now have enough equipment for our patients' rehabilitation. Next, we must learn how to assist them through the process.

84.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_BEFRANKUP_CHARLEMEND_003_000
84.description: Thanks to you, we now have everything we require. 'Tis time to prepare the venue for the high tea. Come, let us go and put smiles on our patients' faces.

85.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_001_000
85.description: Is it true? We have enough daily necessities now?

86.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_001_001
86.description: That we do, and we owe it to our industrious friend.

87.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_001_002
87.description: Wonderful! Now our patients have everything they need! Thank you so much, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

88.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_001_003
88.description: So much, indeed... I must confess, I was surprised to see how much is needed simply to provide our patients with a basic level of comfort.

89.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_001_004
89.description: All these things need replacin' too, so we'll need to keep makin' more. Just like we do at the orphanage.

90.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_001_005
90.description: Truly? You make everything you need by yourselves?

91.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_001_006
91.description: Well, sure. Most things anyway. I mean, who else is goin' to do it for us? Same with the cleanin'─we do that ourselves too.

92.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_001_007
92.description: Ooh, I know! Next time, I'll teach you how to clean. Dustin' and moppin' and all that. We have to do these things regularly. After all, cleanliness is next to healthiness!

93.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_001_008
93.description: I should be grateful for your tutelage, child.

95.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_001
95.description: ...So, taking <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>'s contributions into account, how long will the supplies last?

96.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_002_002
96.description: Um, if we add that to what we already have, that should give us...three weeks!

97.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_003
97.description: Correct yet again! Your numbers have improved in leaps and bounds.

98.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_002_004
98.description: That's thanks to your lessons. You make it easy <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> fun to learn.

99.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_002_005
99.description: Oh, and I've learned how to dress a wound as well! Maurilette taught me!

100.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_006
100.description: Maelie is truly a fast learner. It doubtless stems from her fervent desire to help others.

101.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_007
101.description: While I do not want for the selfsame desire, the old hound that I am, 'tis all I can do to keep up.

102.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_003_000
102.description: Have you heard, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Maurilette's goin' to teach us how to help our patients! With their rehabilitation, that is!

103.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_003_001
103.description: ...What's wrong? You have a stomachache or somethin'?

104.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_003_002
104.description: No, no, nothing of the sort. It's just...I can't help but worry whether I will be able to assist our patients appropriately. What if they do not improve, or worse yet, end up suffering more pain?

105.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_003_003
105.description: Hmmm... You could try and imagine you're hurtin' in the same places. That way you'd know how they feel and can help them better.

106.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_003_004
106.description: Besides, we'll be there too, me and <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. So don't worry. Everything will be fine!

107.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_003_005
107.description: Yes... Yes, you have the right of it. I shall do as you say, and imagine their pain as mine own. Come, let us have Maurilette instruct us at once!

109.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_PATIENT00710_004_001
109.description: I am. I must say, I never thought it could be so pleasant at an infirmary. Thank you, Maelie.

110.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAURILETTE_004_002
110.description: I daresay the event is a success. We owe it to the two of you for conceiving of it and providing what was required.

111.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_003
111.description: Full glad am I to see our patients so enjoying themselves. Long as many of them must stay here, what little additional comfort we can provide goes a long way. And as an unexpected benefit...

112.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_STAFF00710_004_004
112.description: You helped with the preparations as well, did you not? Thank you, Ronantain. You've a good heart.

114.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_006
114.description: ...It served to break down the barriers to which my nephew had clung.

115.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAURILETTE_001_100
115.description: Allow me to thank you all for replenishing the daily necessities. It shall keep us for a good while.

116.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAURILETTE_001_101
116.description: And with Charlemend tutoring Maelie while managing our stores, my fellow nurses and I find our burden greatly lightened. All of which is to say you are doing well.

117.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAURILETTE_001_102
117.description: That being the case, I have a mind to task you with replenishing and managing our medical supplies as well. Do you think you will be up to the task?

118.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_001_103
118.description: Yes, Maurilette! Just leave it to us!

119.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_001_104
119.description: You heard that, Charlemend? We're in charge of medical supplies now!

120.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_001_105
120.description: 'Tis testament to your dedication. Let us keep up our fine form.

121.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_001_106
121.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, there is none we trust more to provide what we need. May we rely upon you once more?

122.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAURILETTE_002_100
122.description: I took the liberty of inspecting our inventory, and I'm pleased to say that all is in good order. The two of you are doing a fine job of managing the medical supplies.

123.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_002_101
123.description: Hehe, that's because Charlemend's been teachin' me my numbers!

124.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAURILETTE_002_102
124.description: I certainly see you teaching Maelie often of late. A more zealous tutor one would be hard-pressed to find.

125.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_103
125.description: Yes, well, one might say 'tis a force of habit.

126.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_104
126.description: I have a nephew, you see─a boy of an age with Maelie─and I daresay I see him in her.

127.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_105
127.description: With my brother passed and firstborn lost, I took him under my wing as my successor, teaching him such knowledge as he needs to one day lead our knights in battle against the dragons.

128.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_106
128.description: Yet now that the Dragonsong War has ended, we must dedicate ourselves not to the taking of life, but the bettering of it.

129.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_107
129.description: However, not all of our countrymen have embraced change. And as a father figure to my nephew, I felt that I must needs practice that which I preach.

130.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_108
130.description: Leading by example, I wished to give him a glimpse of a new Ishgard, one where there is no highborn and lowborn─just fellow Ishgardians striving together for a better tomorrow.

131.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_109
131.description: By that, I must confess that I do not have only the interests of the patients in mind. 'Twas wrong of me not to disclose this fact from the first, and I beg your forgiveness.

132.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAURILETTE_002_110
132.description: No apologies are necessary, Charlemend. Whatever your reasons, you've been naught but an asset to the infirmary. You and Maelie both.

133.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAURILETTE_002_111
133.description: Thus do I have a mind to entrust the two of you with even more responsibilities.

134.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAURILETTE_002_112
134.description: Many of our patients have debilitating injuries, and are in need of rehabilitation. I want you to assist them in their efforts. This is an important task, one that requires you to work closely with the patients.

135.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAURILETTE_002_113
135.description: Now, rehabilitation demands a variety of sophisticated equipment, such that can only be provided by skilled artisans. To wit, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, we must turn to you once more.

136.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_100
136.description: Not only did the event unfold smoothly─by participating in it, my nephew has begun to warm to the idea of a new Ishgard. I couldn't have asked for a better outcome.

137.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_101
137.description: Going forward, 'tis my intent to host high teas on a regular basis, meaning we will continue to require the relevant supplies. I hope you will keep obliging us, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─with those items as well as the usual necessities.

138.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_004_102
138.description: Hehe, you really like workin' here, don't you?

139.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_103
139.description: If truth be told, I had not expected to enjoy myself so. I never would have known this were it not for you and <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

140.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_104
140.description: And with matters at home laid to rest, I may continue doing my part here with an easy heart.

141.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_105
141.description: I trust that you will continue to be at my side, Maelie─as a fellow aide and mentor both.

142.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_MAELIE_004_106
142.description: Oh, you can count on it! It's great fun workin' together, and I learn so much from you as well!

143.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_107
143.description: And you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. We are indebted to you more than words can well express.

144.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_108
144.description: You have done all of us at Ser Vaindreau's Grace a great service, and I pray that you will continue to lend us your expertise.

145.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_109
145.description: Speaking of which...there is one other favor I had been meaning to ask of you.

146.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_110
146.description: Though I have been disguising myself─leastwise, that was my intent─I have failed to fool a single person.

147.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_LCUT_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_111
147.description: As such, I shall shed with disguises, and strive instead to dress in a manner that would better endear myself to citizens and patients both. Whenever you have a spare moment, I would greatly appreciate your insights on outfits.

148.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUPINFO_000_000
148.description: Charlemend is pleased with your efforts. He now considers you an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aide's Able Associate<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

149.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUPINFO_000_001
149.description: Charlemend is delighted with your efforts. He now considers you an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aide's Avid Assistant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

150.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUPINFO_000_002
150.description: Charlemend is overjoyed with your efforts. He now considers you an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aide's Ardent Ally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

151.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUPINFO_000_003
151.description: Charlemend could not be happier with your efforts. He now considers you an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aide's Attentive Angel<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

152.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUPINFO_001_001
152.description: And yet there is still much work to be done if he is to atone for past negligence and provide a shining example for the future of Ishgard. To that end, Charlemend has a new favor to ask of you...

153.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUPINFO_001_002
153.description: Through your efforts, the patients of Ser Vaindreau's Grace have never enjoyed better conditions. It seems, however, that Charlemend has a different sort of favor to ask of you...

154.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_AFTRANKUP_000_001
154.description: The Custom Deliveries list for Charlemend has been updated. To view the new list, speak with Charlemend and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

155.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_AFTRANKUP_001_001
155.description: A new quest continuing the story of Charlemend's efforts at Ser Vaindreau's Grace is now available from Maurilette. Upon its completion, the Custom Deliveries list for Charlemend will be updated.

156.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_AFTRANKUP_002_001
156.description: Future requests will be selected at random from all those you have seen thus far, with the list refreshed once a week (Earth time).

157.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_AFTRANKUP_002_002
157.description: You may review the items currently in demand at any time by speaking with Charlemend and selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

158.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_AFTRANKUP_002_003
158.description: Note that art supplies, art supply materials, and fragrant sweetfish will earn you particularly handsome rewards. Whenever they make an appearance, the effort to procure them will be worth your while.

159.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_AFTRANKUP_002_004
159.description: Furthermore, Charlemend's appearance may now be altered through the use of glamours.

160.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_MAELIE_001_000
160.description: Thanks for bringin' us so much, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

161.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_001_001
161.description: Indeed. 'Tis in no small part due to your contributions that we budding aides are able to discharge our duties. We are truly grateful.

162.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_MAELIE_002_000
162.description: Thanks so much for always helpin' us, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

163.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_002_001
163.description: With your kind assistance, we are being entrusted with tasks of ever greater import. We hope we can continue to depend on you.

164.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_003_000
164.description: I'm pleased to say that our patients have been making excellent progress with their rehabilitation. And in the course of working together, I have managed to strike up a rapport with many of them.

165.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_MAELIE_002_001
165.description: Just earlier, Maurilette told us that we're fully fledged aides now! But we won't rest on these laurels, oh no. We'll keep workin' as hard as ever!

166.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_000
166.description: Not in a very long time have I had the opportunity to learn so much. It makes me feel like a young man again.

167.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_MAELIE_004_001
167.description: Ronantain's been learnin' a lot too. Haven't you, Ronantain?

168.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_RONANTAIN_004_002
168.description: A-Aye, well, I but follow my uncle's example.

169.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_004_003
169.description: It does me well to see the younger generation embrace change. After all, 'tis they who shall lead Ishgard unto the future. Not to say that I won't do my part, but I must work hard if I am to keep up with their youthful vigor!

170.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_005_000
170.description: Not only has my nephew grown accustomed to assisting here─it pleases me to say he takes to the work with great zeal.

171.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_MAELIE_005_001
171.description: We have to wash the bedsheets next! Let's go, Ronantain!

173.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_006_000
173.description: I've not forgotten that you are a busy <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I am truly grateful that you should see fit to lend us so much of your assistance, and not only here at the infirmary.

174.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_006_001
174.description: Among other things, House Durendaire owes much of her newfound prosperity to you.

175.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_006_002
175.description: Your coming and subsequent ending of the Dragonsong War wrought great changes. Changes that many Ishgardians─myself among them─struggled to accept.

176.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_006_003
176.description: But I believe I speak for an ever-growing number of my countrymen when I say we appreciate all that you have done, and continue to do, for our nation.

177.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_RANKUP_CHARLEMEND_006_004
177.description: On behalf of all Ishgardians, I give you my humblest thanks.

178.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_AFTWEEKLY_000_000
178.description: You have delivered the weekly maximum of six items to Charlemend. You may begin making deliveries again starting <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).

179.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_QUEST_CHARLEMEND_000_000
179.description: ...Hm? As much as battle attire becomes you, perhaps you should don something more suitable for our lesson with Maurilette.

180.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_QUEST_SYSTEM_000_002
180.description: In order to undertake the next quest, speak with Maurilette as a Disciple of the Hand or the Land.

181.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_QUEST_CHARLEMEND_000_010
181.description: Their pain as mine own, their pain as mine own...

182.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_QUEST_SYSTEM_000_011
182.description: Custom deliveries cannot be made while the quest “Those Who Serve” is in progress. They will become available again once the quest is completed.

183.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER7_00710_QUEST_CHARLEMEND_000_015
183.description: I apologize for my nephew's outburst. He is a good lad, truly.
